rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken Hong Kong farewell before sleep or at night.

example.english: Ming, I have to get up early tomorrow, good night!
example.traditional: 阿明，我聽日要早起，早唞呀！
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 zou2 hei2 zou2 tau2 aa3

rows.note: Choose this in writing, formal contexts, or when intentionally using the standard “good night”; everyday speech usually prefers 早唞.

example.english: Colleagues, the meeting ends here; good night, everyone.
example.traditional: 各位同事，會議到此結束，祝大家晚安。
example.jyutping: gok3 wai2 tung4 si6 wui6 ji5 dou3 ci2 git3 cuk1 zuk1 daai6 gaa1 maan5 on1
